SELECT * FROM ( SELECT sh.id AS shop_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(sh.poi_id, ''), CAST(sh.id AS CHAR)) AS poi_id, COALESCE(sh.poi_name, sh.name) AS shop_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(sh.contact_phone, ''), NULLIF(sh.phone, '')) AS shop_phone, COALESCE(ev.h5_app_open_count, 0) AS h5_app_open_count, COALESCE(ev.h5_home_page_view_count, 0) AS h5_home_page_view_count, COALESCE(ev.h5_log_page_view_count, 0) AS h5_log_page_view_count, COALESCE(ev.h5_power_page_view_count, 0) AS h5_power_page_view_count, COALESCE(ev.h5_knowledge_page_view_count, 0) AS h5_knowledge_page_view_count, COALESCE(ev.h5_support_page_view_count, 0) AS h5_support_page_view_count, COALESCE(ev.h5_support_entry_click_count, 0) AS h5_support_entry_click_count, COALESCE(ev.h5_external_link_click_count, 0) AS h5_external_link_click_count, COALESCE(ev.h5_recharge_submit_click_count, 0) AS h5_recharge_submit_click_count, COALESCE(ev.h5_redemption_apply_success_count, 0) AS h5_redemption_apply_success_count, COALESCE(ev.h5_log_detail_expand_count, 0) AS h5_log_detail_expand_count, COALESCE(ev.h5_knowledge_action_count, 0) AS h5_knowledge_action_count, COALESCE(ev.pc_comment_log_view_count, 0) AS pc_comment_log_view_count, COALESCE(ev.pc_knowledge_view_count, 0) AS pc_knowledge_view_count, COALESCE(st.h5_auto_reply_change_count, 0) AS h5_auto_reply_change_count, COALESCE(st.h5_negative_appeal_change_count, 0) AS h5_negative_appeal_change_count, COALESCE(st.pc_auto_reply_change_count, 0) AS pc_auto_reply_change_count, COALESCE(st.pc_negative_appeal_change_count, 0) AS pc_negative_appeal_change_count, COALESCE(st.system_auto_disable_count, 0) AS system_auto_disable_count FROM mt_shop sh LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.shop_id, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_APP_OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_app_open_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_PAGE_VIEW' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.context_json, '$.pageCode')) = 'HOME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_home_page_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_PAGE_VIEW' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.context_json, '$.pageCode')) = 'LOG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_log_page_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_PAGE_VIEW' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.context_json, '$.pageCode')) = 'POWER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_power_page_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_PAGE_VIEW' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.context_json, '$.pageCode')) = 'KNOWLEDGE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_knowledge_page_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_PAGE_VIEW' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.context_json, '$.pageCode')) = 'SUPPORT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_support_page_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_SUPPORT_ENTRY_CLICK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_support_entry_click_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_EXTERNAL_LINK_CLICK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_external_link_click_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_RECHARGE_SUBMIT_CLICK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_recharge_submit_click_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_REDEMPTION_APPLY_RESULT' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.context_json, '$.result')) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_redemption_apply_success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_LOG_DETAIL_EXPAND' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_log_detail_expand_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'H5' AND e.event_type = 'H5_KNOWLEDGE_ACTION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_knowledge_action_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'ADMIN_BACKEND' AND e.event_type = 'PC_COMMENT_LOG_VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pc_comment_log_view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_source = 'ADMIN_BACKEND' AND e.event_type = 'PC_KNOWLEDGE_VIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pc_knowledge_view_count FROM user_behavior_event e WHERE e.event_time >= #{startAt} AND e.event_time < #{endAt} GROUP BY e.shop_id ) ev ON ev.shop_id = sh.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT h.shop_id, SUM(CASE WHEN h.change_source = 'H5' AND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_auto_reply_change_count, SUM(CASE WHEN h.change_source = 'H5' AND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS h5_negative_appeal_change_count, SUM(CASE WHEN h.change_source = 'ADMIN' AND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pc_auto_reply_change_count, SUM(CASE WHEN h.change_source = 'ADMIN' AND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pc_negative_appeal_change_count, SUM(CASE WHEN h.change_source = 'SYSTEM' AND h.change_reason = 'POWER_BALANCE_NOT_ENOUGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS system_auto_disable_count FROM mt_comment_reply_setting_history h WHERE h.create_time >= #{startAt} AND h.create_time < #{endAt} GROUP BY h.shop_id ) st ON st.shop_id = sh.id WHERE 1 = 1
) stats
mapper.sql: JSON_VALID(h.before_snapshot_json) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.before_snapshot_json, '$.autoReplyEnabled')) IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.before_snapshot_json, '$.autoReplyEnabled')) != IF(h.auto_reply_enabled = 1, 'true', 'false')

JSON_VALID(h.before_snapshot_json) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.before_snapshot_json, '$.negativeCommentAppealEnabled')) IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(h.before_snapshot_json, '$.negativeCommentAppealEnabled')) != IF(h.negative_comment_appeal_enabled = 1, 'true', 'false')

choose.when: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_user_shop_binding usb WHERE usb.shop_id = sh.id )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_sales_user_shop_binding usb WHERE usb.shop_id = sh.id )

sql.if: AND ( CAST(sh.id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(sh.poi_id, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(sh.epoi_id, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(sh.poi_name, sh.name, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(NULLIF(sh.contact_phone, ''), NULLIF(sh.phone, ''), '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

when.test: sortColumn != null and sortColumn != '' and sortDirection == 'ASC'
sortColumn != null and sortColumn != '' and sortDirection == 'DESC'

choose.otherwise: ORDER BY h5_app_open_count DESC, shop_id DESC
